_meta.description: Curated dataset of regulatory developments relevant to stablecoin networks, crypto markets and cross-border payments. Each entry carries a primary public source. Ingestion validates, classifies and persists this data; analytics derive reproducible aggregates. See docs/DATA.md for provenance and update instructions.

events.title: EU MiCA stablecoin rules enter into force
events.summary: Title III of the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) applies to asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens, requiring authorisation, reserve requirements and redemption rights for stablecoin issuers operating in the EU.

events.title: EU MiCA full application for crypto-asset service providers
events.summary: From 30 December 2024 the full MiCA regime applies across the EU, covering CASPs, issuance, disclosure and market abuse rules. Platforms serving EU users must be licensed or wind down EU services.

events.title: EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) applies
events.summary: DORA imposes ICT risk management, incident reporting and third-party (including cloud and blockchain infrastructure) oversight obligations on EU financial entities, with materiality thresholds for major incidents.

events.title: FATF updated guidance on the Travel Rule for virtual assets
events.summary: The Financial Action Task Force expanded its Recommendations to require VASPs to share originator and beneficiary information on virtual asset transfers, driving global Travel Rule compliance tooling.

events.title: FSB and G20 endorse global framework for crypto-asset regulation
events.summary: The Financial Stability Board published high-level recommendations for regulating crypto-asset activities and markets and global stablecoin arrangements, endorsed by G20 leaders in New Delhi.

events.title: US Executive Order 14067 on responsible development of digital assets
events.summary: The White House ordered a whole-of-government approach to digital assets, including research into a potential US CBDC and reports on the risks and benefits of digital asset markets.

events.title: US SEC approves spot Bitcoin ETFs
events.summary: The SEC approved 11 spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products, signalling a regulatory opening for crypto-asset exposure through traditional securities rails and attracting institutional flows.

events.title: US SEC Staff Accounting Bulletin 121 on crypto custody
events.summary: SAB 121 required entities safeguarding customer crypto-assets to record liabilities and disclosures, materially raising the cost of bank crypto custody until later rescinded by the SEC in 2025.

events.title: US House passes FIT21 market structure bill
events.summary: The Financial Innovation and Technology for the 21st Century Act passed the House, proposing a market-structure framework and commodity/securities split for digital assets, with CFTC oversight for digital commodities.

events.title: UK FCA cryptoasset financial promotions regime
events.summary: The FCA brought cryptoasset promotions within the financial promotions regime, requiring UK firms marketing crypto to consumers to be authorised or use an approved route, with strict risk warnings.

events.title: Japan's stablecoin legal framework takes effect
events.summary: Japan's amended Payment Services Act legalised stablecoins as electronic payment instruments, restricting issuance to licensed banks, trust companies and fund transfer service providers.

events.title: MAS finalises Singapore stablecoin regulatory framework
events.summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore published its final framework for single-currency stablecoins, covering reserve management, redemption rights, capital and disclosure for MAS-regulated stablecoins.

events.title: Swiss FINMA issues stablecoin guidance
events.summary: FINMA clarified that stablecoin issuers may require a banking licence under Swiss law and set expectations for reserve backing, redemption and anti-money-laundering compliance.

events.title: US OFAC sanctions Tornado Cash mixer
events.summary: OFAC added the Tornado Cash mixing protocol and associated addresses to the SDN list, imposing US sanctions that reshaped compliance expectations for privacy and transaction-batching tooling.

events.title: US IRS finalises crypto broker reporting rules
events.summary: Final Treasury/IRS regulations require brokers — including some decentralised front-ends and exchanges — to report gross proceeds and, later, cost basis for digital asset dispositions on Form 1099-DA.

events.title: Hong Kong virtual asset service provider licensing regime
events.summary: Hong Kong's VASP licensing regime under the Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance took effect, requiring SFC licensing for platforms offering virtual asset services to Hong Kong users.

events.title: Brazil's crypto regulatory framework enacted
events.summary: Law 14.478/2022 established Brazil's legal framework for virtual asset service providers, requiring authorisation from the central bank and setting consumer and AML obligations.

events.title: EU GDPR applies to blockchain data processors
events.summary: The General Data Protection Regulation's application to immutable ledgers raised unresolved tensions between the right to erasure and append-only records, shaping on-chain data minimisation practices.

events.title: NYDFS requires USDC reserves held in segregated accounts
events.summary: The New York Department of Financial Services authorised the Gemini dollar under requirements that reserves be held in segregated accounts with monthly attestations, a template later applied to USDC.
events.sourceName: New York State Department of Financial Services

events.title: Circle obtains MiCA e-money authorisation for USDC
events.summary: Circle became the first global stablecoin issuer authorised under MiCA's e-money regime, allowing USDC to be distributed to EU customers while other issuers paused EU offerings.
